_: THE ESTABLISHMENT — every post the institution needs, why it exists, and
Two kinds of post. STANDING posts exist because the institution exists:
they are hired on a date, whatever the enrolment. SCALING posts are
created by a threshold — learners under instruction, instructors to
manage, executive learners to serve — and are always hired as whole
people, one term before the workload that needs them arrives.
Teaching staff are not on this list. Their number is derived every term
from the academic hours the service specification requires (engine.mjs).
Salaries are the April 2025 figures of the Office for National Statistics'
earnings survey, carried forward to each year of the plan at the annual pay
rise. Teaching is online and recruited nationally, so academic salaries
are UK figures; the establishment works from London, so its salaries are
London figures wherever the survey publishes a reliable one. Pounds are
converted to dollars at the rate in policy.json.
Offices are named here; people are not. No holder is published for any

employerNiRate.s: Employer Class 1 National Insurance, 2026/27. HMRC, Rates and thresholds for employers 2026 to 2027 — gov.uk/guidance/rates-and-thresholds-for-employers-2026-to-2027, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

employerNiThresholdGbp.s: Employer NI secondary threshold, £5,000 a year, 2026/27; held flat through the plan. HMRC, Rates and thresholds for employers 2026 to 2027 — gov.uk/guidance/rates-and-thresholds-for-employers-2026-to-2027, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

pensionRate.s: The College pays five per cent of salary into a workplace pension — above the statutory employer minimum of three per cent of qualifying earnings (GOV.UK, Workplace pensions: what you, your employer and the government pay, retrieved 23 Sep 2026)

employmentAllowanceGbp.s: Employment Allowance: reduces the employer's National Insurance bill by up to £10,500 a year. HMRC, Rates and thresholds for employers 2026 to 2027 — gov.uk/guidance/rates-and-thresholds-for-employers-2026-to-2027, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

apprenticeshipLevyRate.s: Apprenticeship Levy: 0.5% of the annual pay bill, payable where the pay bill exceeds £3 million. HMRC, Pay Apprenticeship Levy — gov.uk/guidance/pay-apprenticeship-levy, updated 6 Apr 2026

apprenticeshipLevyAllowanceGbp.s: Levy allowance of £15,000 a year set against the levy. HMRC, Pay Apprenticeship Levy — gov.uk/guidance/pay-apprenticeship-levy, updated 6 Apr 2026

salaryBasisYear.s: The survey salaries are for April 2025 (ONS, ASHE 2025 provisional — ons.gov.uk/employmentandlabourmarket/peopleinwork/earningsandworkinghours, released 23 Oct 2025).
